packageRules.description: Flux controllers and the flux-operator move together
Keep the CRD manifests in kubernetes/crds in step with their chart
llama.cpp ships build-number tags. The bundle's apps/llamacpp preset assumes a variant segment (server-vulkan-bN) that these pins do not carry, so the variant is optional here.
rustfs release candidates. Default docker versioning treats the text after the dash as a compatibility suffix that must match exactly, so rc.2 never sees rc.3.

cnpg-vchord tags are '<semver>-<build timestamp>-<pg major>-<distro>'. Drop the timestamp so rebuilds of the same version are not upgrades, and hold the pg major and distro as compatibility so it stays on the running Postgres line.

The agentgateway chart registry carries v2.2.x tags that predate its whole 1.x line (v2.2.1 was pushed 2026-02-17, v1.5.0 on 2026-08-27) because the project restarted its numbering at 1.0.0 in March 2026, so a docker lookup proposes v2.2.1 as an upgrade. The OCIRepositories carry a '# renovate: datasource=github-tags depName=agentgateway/agentgateway' annotation instead, and the GitHub repo has no v2 tag at all. Disable the flux manager's own lookup so the same tag: line is not proposed twice.
Major bumps get their own PR and a visible label
